checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Open hands rest beside the body on the mat.
checks.feet: Feet alternately lift and return while pelvis remains elevated and level, upper back and hands supported.
checks.movement: Maintain a raised level pelvis and upper back support, alternate bent-knee foot lifts. Each side rises for 1.5 seconds, pauses for 1 second, lowers for 1.5 seconds.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
